items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What, Rabinac was what you did?

ctx.x: No, that's the only time that it would happen when I got hurt.
What, Rabinac was what you did?

No. Nope. You know, what I really think happened, the police stopped me and said I was speeding and I was drunk and they took me to jail. But what I really think it was, this happened in 1963. It was during the time they were having these Freedom Rides. And I was going to Monroe. This happened in North Louisiana. And I was going up there and I was pulling the trail. I had a trail on the back of my car. And I guess police must have thought we was coming up there to try to create some kind of disturbance. So it was…
